result.title: BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication
result.summary: Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BrandEval 双轨基准：BrandEval-Static 评测利益相关者感知的危机沟通策略分析，BrandEval-Dynamic 在多智能体沙盒 BrandPolis 中对回复策略做动态压力测试，并构建中文危机回应数据集 BrandSRD 及基于 Strategic Rationale 的参考智能体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「静态策略质量与动态长时程结果不完全一致、动态压力测试才暴露尾部失败」的评测思路，可能为 LVR 的长时程推理与动态评测设计提供对照线索；但论文不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，联系较间接，可供核查。
